findings.text: non-blocking: the served view calls plan_blocker_state without the released argument it defines (reckon/roadmap.py:1198, default False), while the roadmap's own call passes released=slug in released_by_clear (reckon/roadmap.py:3453); so a plan stored status=blocked whose cleared blocker a probe has already released is given the synthesized persisted/unrecorded blocker (reckon/roadmap.py:1243-1249) on the served view and reads blocked, where the manifest's own fixture reads ready through the roadmap. Reproduced on the reviewed head: plan_blocker_state(row) gives effective_status blocked with blocking [('persisted','unrecorded')], plan_blocker_state(row, released=True) gives active with blocking []; before this change the served view synthesized no placeholder, so it read active and agreed with the released roadmap row. This is a divergence in the very fact the node unifies, and the comment at reckon/serve.py:2060-2062 claims the two surfaces 'cannot disagree', which is stronger than what landed. The manifest discloses the asymmetry in evidence_inputs item (4); it is recorded here rather than as blocking because the node's declared measure covers the decision/gate/free triad only.

item_verdicts.call_sites: the change reaches production through _derive_lifecycle (reckon/serve.py:1740, :1808) and through _build_roadmap (reckon/roadmap.py:3448), whose callers are reckon/serve.py:1859, reckon/mcp.py:2146, reckon/mcp.py:3180, reckon/crew/plan_review.py:3107, reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:1085, reckon/flight.py:2635 and reckon/graph_target.py:204.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 9608e78d5: the single commit 74db0ba14 adds plan_blocker_state to reckon/roadmap.py, rewires _build_roadmap onto it, imports it into reckon/serve.py:_derive_lifecycle, adds the parity test file and the evidence fragment; 4 files, 330 insertions, 93 deletions, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_the_served_view_reads_the_roadmaps_blockers.py building a decision-held, a gate-held and a free plan and comparing the two surfaces, plus the negative control; the manifest records that file at head 4 passed EXIT=0 and at base 2 failed/2 passed, and negative-control.log records the restored own-assembly arm at 2 failed/2 passed EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that _derive_lifecycle takes each plan's blockers and blocked state from the roadmap's assembly through one exported function and keeps none of its own; at 74db0ba14 reckon/serve.py:2063 calls roadmap.plan_blocker_state and the function is defined at reckon/roadmap.py:1192, with the served view's own split_unpassed_gates/effective_status assembly gone from that loop.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it is complete, records commit 74db0ba14, four changed paths, the head/base suite arms with their logs and failure ids, and a negative-control log whose last line is a bare EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/serve.py, reckon/roadmap.py, tests/test_the_served_view_reads_the_roadmaps_blockers.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; git diff --stat 9608e78d5 74db0ba14 changes exactly the first four files and no path outside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_served_view_reads_the_roadmaps_blockers.py:147 fails when the served view stops reading the shared assembly, as negative-control.log shows at 'served {} vs roadmap {decision: {transport}}' with EXIT=1, and the :159/:169/:176 literals fail if decision/gate/free classification regresses; no assertion compares a value against an input the test itself passed in.
justifications.evidence: base-suite.log (revision 9608e78d5, 368 passed/3 failed/EXIT=1) and head-suite.log (74db0ba14, 369 passed/2 failed/EXIT=1) are recorded in the manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite, the two base-only failures are the new parity cases, and a head-only environment failure (test_spa_shell_geometry) is disclosed and shown not to follow the content by an export without .git.
justifications.fit: plan_blocker_state at reckon/roadmap.py:1192 sits in the module that owns the assembly and follows the module's existing long-docstring and per-kind-row idiom, and no added filename, symbol or comment carries a plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/serve.py:2063 now sources blockers and effective_status from roadmap.plan_blocker_state (reckon/roadmap.py:1192) and the loop keeps no assembly of its own, which is the deliverable; the released-flag omission at reckon/serve.py:2063 leaves one population disagreeing, so not full marks.
justifications.reuse: the change removes a duplicate assembly rather than adding one: the roadmap's inline blocker list and the served view's separate list both collapse onto roadmap.plan_blocker_state, which is the module that already owned the capability, and a search of reckon/ for other blocker assembly found only direct split_unpassed_gates consumers that this node's goal does not reach.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 9608e78d5 74db0ba14 lists exactly reckon/roadmap.py, reckon/serve.py, tests/test_the_served_view_reads_the_roadmaps_blockers.py and the declared evidence fragment, 4 files and nothing outside them.
